lyrics.text: Sound before sight
Beat before breath
Music in my marrow
Running from the rest
Music in my marrow, I move like a warning
Meeko on the run, gone before the morning
Feet hit the ground like a code in my chest
Every step screams go, I don't ever rest
Gates fly past, walls blur gray
I read the whole world in the sounds it makes
Clack of the chain, snap of the lock
I know every corner by the way it talks
Pulse in my jaw, heat in my veins
Born with the rhythm like it came with my name
I don't chase the noise, I become it
Run too deep, can't outrun it
Hit the wall, rebound fast
Every obstacle built to last
But I last longer, I move stronger
Every second I stay the beat grows louder
Here it comes, feel the floor
Three, two, one, break the door
Sound drops low, pressure builds
Let it go, let it spill
Meeko, Meeko, move
Meeko, Meeko, move
Can't stop now
I am the groove
Neon on the glass and the whole block stutters
Quick feet, quick thoughts, no room for the clutter
Hear the guard shift, hear the fence hum
I'm already three moves past where they come
Left foot, right foot, split-second living
Every breath I take feels borrowed and given
I don't look back, that's a dead-end spell
I was built for the sprint, I know it too well
Sound in the alley, sound in the rain
Sound in the static when they call my name
I turn every echo into a map
Find my way forward in the crack and the snap
Gate on the left, gate on the right
Hit every mark in the middle of the night
Read the rhythm, read the space
No one alive runs at this pace
Chest tight, lungs burn
One more push, one more turn
Beat drops hard, world goes white
Meeko moves, Meeko ignites
Meeko, Meeko, move
Meeko, Meeko, move
He can't be caught
He was made for the groove
I hear the world before it ever arrives
Warnings in the walls, already inside
Metal on metal, then the hush before
That's the moment I'm through the door
I don't need luck, I need timing
Need one clean beat and the whole thing climbing
Shoulders low, eyes sharp, breath cold
Speed in my blood and a story retold
They see a blur, I see patterns
I see the trap before the whole thing shatters
I see the path in the wreckage spread
And I'm already gone when they turn their head
Sound like a signal, sound like a wire
Running so fast I'm setting fires
Every lane lit, every beat hit
I don't slow down, I don't submit
Hold that breath
Hear that click
One step slow
Then it flips
Silence bends
Ground drops out
Meeko hears it
There's no doubt
Feel it in the marrow
Feel it in the bone
Every echo tells him
He was never alone
The world throws gates, I throw moves back
Sound in my bones keeps me on track
Every gate a test, every jump a dare
I was built for this, I was born right there
Sound shifts low then it climbs
Meeko reads it every single time
Left wall screams, right wall cracks
I'm through the gap before it reacts
Short breath, sharp mind, clear eyes
I see the path through the neon lights
No one taught me this, it was always there
Music in my blood, music in the air
Hit the beat hard, feel the pulse surge
Every clean land pushing to the verge
Stack the combo, watch it grow
Meeko locked in, locked in the flow
Everything quiet
Everything still
One beat left
And it's in for the kill
Meeko, Meeko, move
Meeko, Meeko, move
He is the rhythm
And the rhythm won't lose
Sound in his blood
It was never done
Never done
Never done
Born in the beat
Already won
